subject.title: fix(qa): retain runtime tool evidence after agent completion

question: Should this PR become the canonical successor to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/113470, with the overlapping PR closed or rebased only for any uniquely missing behavior?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same release-QA persistence race, and this protected maintainer item should not be auto-closed or selected over the competing implementation without an explicit ownership decision.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Review and land this rebased multi-session-aware repair, then close the overlapping PR after confirming no unique regression coverage is lost.

options.title: Prefer the earlier PR
options.body: Keep the earlier repair as the landing path only if it contains a proven session-eligibility or persistence behavior missing here, then port that narrow coverage.

options.title: Unify before landing
options.body: Ask for one consolidated branch if the two implementations contain distinct necessary behavior that cannot be cleanly selected from review.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land this rebased multi-session-aware repair, then close the overlapping PR after confirming no unique regression coverage is lost.
